You throw the first thing you manage to grab a hold of in your bag. The fire burns it to a crisp before rapidly subsiding.
You scramble to get a potion from your bag and quickly empty its contents. NL As if it were alive and aware of your intentions,
the fire retreats before you can capture any of it.

You hide in a small nearby cave, you barely fit, but you hope the fire will not find you here. NL

${modID}:ThreoEahtaTrainingEvent.NAME: Threo and Eahta
DESCRIPTIONS: A horned man and a horned woman both sit at the campfire as they happily enjoy meat and booze. They notice you before you are close enough to understand what they are talking about. NL "How amusing to see a new face around these parts," the man's voice raspy yet booming voice calls out to you. " Come, sit with us. A meal taste best when in good company." NL After some deliberation you sit with the pair. They offer to share their feast with you. You learn through conversing that the woman's name is Threo and the man's name is Eahta. They are both mighty warriors that specialize on their weapons of choice.
After some conversation, you decide to rest for a while. When you wake up, the three of you exchange goodbyes and go your separate ways.

Threo excitedly grabs her oversized axe and prepares to spar with you. NL "I never back down from a good fight!" NL You spar with Threo. Her blows are far mightier than you expected from someone of her frame and her fighting style is as unpredicable as it is deadly. You don't get by unscathed, but sparing with her has made you more resilient and more skilled in ways you did not expect. NL Afterwards, the three of you exchange goodbyes and go your separate ways.

Eahta stands and grabs his katanas. NL "Very well, it is the duty of all masters to teach the next generation." NL You spar with Eahta. His blows are precise to a fault. You can tell he is more focused on ensuring you learn something from this fight than on winning. You make sure to learn all you can so that his lessons do not go to waste. NL Afterwards, the three of you exchange goodbyes and go your separate ways.

${modID}:ScalesOfDominionEvent.NAME: The Scales
DESCRIPTIONS: You reach an shrine containing a statue of a large Primal stands holding a set of scales in its left hand. Despite holding nothing, the scales are unbalanced, with the left side lower than the right side.

As you balance the scales, you feel yourself become weaker. Once they are perfectly balanced, a voice rings inside your head. NL "Your offering has been accepted." NL The statue releases the scales, which now rest in your hands.

As you further unbalance the scales, you feel your injuries heal, and a voice rings inside your head. NL "Your decision has been made." NL You notice the eyes of the statue now glare directly at you and decide it is best to leave.

As you accept the power she offers you hear loud roars and the sound of metal blades clashing atop a battlefield. The abilities and techniques of the #rIronclad are now within reach.
You reject her power, but, strangely, you feel stronger nonetheless. It seems that you have gained greater affinity with your own power since it remains undiluted with that of others.

${modID}:BorgerEvent.NAME: The Chariot
DESCRIPTIONS: You reach what appears to be the remains of a battlefield. A man dressed in fun armor sits atop a nearby rock drinking as he gazes towards the destruction left behind. NL "A word of warning, stranger. Do not dwell long in the battlefield. With enough time, even victory will ring hollow."

You talk with the man. He introduces himself as Geisenborger. He has inhabited battlefields for a very long time, always gone undefeated. You try to learn as much as you can from the seasoned warrior's tales. After some time, he gives you a smile and produces a small trinket from his pockets. NL "Take this. I am hoping to forever leave the battlefield, and it would be a shame for you to fall before you are witness my true calling." NL Geisenborger then stands, and after saying his goodbyes, leaves.

"Do as you wish," the man says, seemingly unbothered by your intentions. NL You search the battlefield in search for something useful. Although there is not much that has not been destroyed already, you do find a useful tool.

${modID}:RoseQueensEvent.NAME: The Forest of Roses
DESCRIPTIONS: Thick thorny bushes stand in your path. You can see a small pathway that could lead you through. However, progress is both slow and painful. Alternatively, you could simply cut down the bushes as you progress.

You move through the thorny path. Each step is accompanied with the painful cuts of spines poking at and cutting you from every direction. Once you have finally freed yourself from the ordeal, a soft voice addresses you from behind your back. NL #r"Thank #ryou. #rYour #rrestraint #rand #rkindness #rhas #rnot #rgone #runnoticed." NL You turn around, but find no one there. Instead, you notice a rose like crystal has been placed in your hand.
#r"What #ra #rshame..."

${modID}:SeofonAndNiyon.NAME: Seofon and Niyon
DESCRIPTIONS: You encounter a duo of a tall man and an abnormally small woman. They are both happily enjoying playing music before they notice you. NL "You're a face I haven't seen before. Come, enjoy some music with us. You can even join if you so wish.", the man says.

"Do not worry about your skill, simply enjoy yourself", he says as the woman begins playing her harp. NL Hesitantly, you sing alongside them, the music seems to relieve you of your worries, if only for a moment.

You ask them if you can rest in their proximity. The man laughs and says, "Of course! Feel free." The woman does not respond, but smiles softly, and as you sit down to rest, she begins to play a lullaby with her harp to help you sleep.

${modID}:CaOngEvent.NAME: The Flying Whale
DESCRIPTIONS: You see a giant whale, adorned with gold and jewels fly above you. As it moves, it showers everything bellow it with the bright sparkles it releases.
As you touch one of the sparkles, you feel a warm invisible veil cover your body. Its protection gives you a peculiar sense of safety.
You collect one of the sparkles in a bottle for closer inspection. However, as soon as you close the lid, the sparkle expands and transforms into a familiar liquid.

${modID}:OdinEvent.NAME: Fast As Lightning
DESCRIPTIONS: A man on a horse passes beside you at blistering speed.
He does not respond, but somehow, you are now able to follow his movements far better.

${modID}:YatimaEvent.NAME: Prayers to the Moon
DESCRIPTIONS: #b"Yatima, #bI'm #bcounting #bon #byou," you hear the voice of a man say before a woman with many metallic tendrils responds #r"Limiter #rUnlocked." NL As she speaks, you can feel a flow of energy pass through you as if you were a conduit for some greater purpose.

You allow the energy to flow through you. As it does, visions of the moon flash before your eyes. Followed by a feeling of nostalgia, then one of abandonment, and one of comfort. As you awaken from the dream, you hear Yatima's voice once again, #r"Thank #ryou."

You attempt to retain as much energy as you can in the hopes of strengthening yourself. As you do, the energy rampages and crimson-colored crystal spikes jet out from your body. Right before you wake, you see Yatima glance at you with pity in her eyes. You return to the waking world to find your body intact, though some small chunks of crimson-colored crystal remain in your arm.

${modID}:JewelResortCasinoEvent.NAME: Jewel Resort Casino
DESCRIPTIONS: Looking for a safe location to rest, you are beckoned by the sound of... music? Following the cheerful melody you reach a building. NL #y"Welcome #yto #ythe #yJewel #yResort #yCasino, #ywhere, #yeven #yin #ytime #yof #ydistress, #yyou #ycan #ylet #ygo #yof #yyour #yworries."
"Such luck! Would you like to play another round?"
"What a shame. Oh well, better luck next time!"
"Hope you had fun! No refunds."

${modID}:IlsaEvent.NAME: Ilsa's Regiment
DESCRIPTIONS: You decide to take a small rest before a woman dressed in a white and red uniform approaches you and screams. NL "You, soldier! What do you think you're doing slacking off there?! We are under attack, so you better get your ass up and get back in formation before I shove my boot up it! You hear me, maggot?! Get the back in the fray! NOW!"

After the fight, the woman approaches you again. NL "You are not one of our guys, aren't you? I could tell. You fight different from our troops. Nevertheless, your help was greatly appreciated in this operation. I am Ilsa. I am leading the operation against these Primals. I do not have much to offer as payment for your service, but do pass through our medical center before you leave. I can at least let you treat some of your injuries as recompense for your efforts."

"You're a civilian?! Then follow me, I'll take you to the closest shelter." The woman guides you to a safe location. "I am Ilsa. I am leading the operation of protecting this city. Take this." She hands you a set of medical supplies. "If you think you don't need them, give them to anyone you find who does. And don't go wandering around! A civilian like you could get seriously injured in a situation like this!" Ilsa then swiftly leaves before you can even respond.
OPTIONS: [Explain you are not one of her soldiers] #gObtain #ghealing #gpotion

${modID}:AstralBlessingEvent.NAME: Blessings of the Mother
DESCRIPTIONS: "I am so happy to see you recover the power we have left behind, my child. However, I see they have lost much of their power. I cannot restore them to their prime from where I am, but strengthening to a more acceptable state should be easy."
"Done. Good luck, my child."
